title: The runner and placement routes are in the route index (#878)

story.as_a: session wiring up the delivery loop
story.i_want_to: list_routes to show every route needed to bring a runner online
story.so_that: a session can discover enrolment, the pool, placement and dispatch revocation without reading source

rationale: Seven served routes are absent from the curated index, so a session that found the intake tools still cannot find how to enrol a runner or place a dispatch.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/v1/routes lists GET and POST /api/v1/runners, DELETE /api/v1/runners/:id, GET /api/v1/runners/pool, POST /api/v1/runners/:runner_id/dispatches, GET /api/v1/dispatches/enrolled-keys, POST /api/v1/dispatches/:id/revoke and POST /api/v1/stories/:id/merge-precondition.
Each listed row names its required role and the MCP tool that reaches it.
The route-discovery test fails when a route under /api/v1/runners, /api/v1/dispatches or a merge-precondition path is served but not indexed.

test_cases.name: index lists the loop's routes
expected_results: each route present with role and tool

test_cases.name: drift guard
steps: compare served routes under the loop prefixes with the index

technical_notes: Index: lib/loopctl_web/controllers/route_discovery_controller.ex; authoritative list from mix phx.routes
non_goals: Does not index the other unindexed /api/v1 routes (#872)
